5. **P2 — Catalog inspection does not ensure that host providers are available.**  
   [jido.connect.catalog.ex:22](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/mix/tasks/jido.connect.catalog.ex:22) has no application configuration requirement. Mix can locate this dependency task without compiling or adding the host application to the code path. A private provider configured through `catalog_modules` can therefore be omitted as an unavailable module. Installed dependency metadata can load correctly; that is a separate case.  
   **Correction:** Require `app.config` before discovery. This makes host code available without starting its supervision tree.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.
title: Catalog inspection does not ensure that host providers are available
